id: AT-RN-06 (HOME-GUARD: no case reaches the real home)
note: HOME-GUARD (0.1.2): a kit test elsewhere ran a planted hook with the real HOME and wiped ~/.claude/settings.json; the settings writer (lib/settings_write.pm) writes ${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/settings.json, and the helper writes its handoff root and watch logs under $XDG_STATE_HOME, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA and the folder options. Inside a case the runner's own HOME is the case's $HOME and no CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, CLAUDE* or XDG_* name is set (the runner drops the caller's at start). With stand-ins for the real HOME, the account's home, the config folder and the state folders given (all under $TMP: no link into the real home is made), home_guard refuses, before the fork, a helper call or command whose HOME is a real home (by real path or device and inode: a link to it, or another case of its name), missing, empty, relative or outside the temp folders, whose HOME or CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR has a `..` part (the kernel applies it after links: $TMP/L/.. with L a link into the real home is the real home), whose CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is a real config folder (also when TMPDIR is the home or another case of it) or not under a temp folder, whose config folder (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, else $HOME/.claude) or its settings.json leads by real path to a real config folder or outside temp, or is a dangling link (links inside temp are taken), whose XDG_STATE_HOME, XDG_CACHE_HOME, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA, folder option or CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR is outside temp, relative (an option), through `..`, or in a real config or state folder, and a declared builtin home at the account's home. A child run of the runner over two case-local cases (a helper call with no HOME; one with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR outside the temp folders) fails both with the guard's line; a child run started with the state folders at stand-ins passes none of them to its case, and nothing lands there

steps.name: the guard and the runner's own environment
a child run: both helper calls refused, both cases fail

stdout_has: ^#   runner error: HOME-GUARD: helper /bin/sh: no HOME \(the helper would use the account's home\); not started$
^#   runner error: HOME-GUARD: helper /bin/sh: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR /nonexistent-home-guard-cfg is not under a temp folder; not started$

steps.name: a child run started with the state folders at stand-ins: its case gets none, nothing lands there
